formDescription: Shown when requesting records about a child under 12. Collects the child's identifying information and requires an attached proof-of-guardianship document.

middle_name.title: Middle name
middle_name.description: Child's legal middle name, if any.

also_known_as.title: Also known as
also_known_as.description: Any other name(s) the child is or was known by.

date_of_birth.title: What is the child's date of birth?
date_of_birth.description: Child's date of birth. Must not be a future date.

proof_of_guardianship.title: Attach copy of proof of guardianship
proof_of_guardianship.description: A single-file attachment proving the applicant's guardianship of the child (e.g. court order, declaration form).
